title: Phase 11 – Awakening the Vault & Ancient Enemies

systems.name: 11.1 The Vault of the Forgotten Sun
systems.notes: Endgame biome accessed only with a dreadnaught. A dormant moving city. Restoring its heart activates the Sun Engine, triggering global changes.
tasks: Design Vault biome (ancient machinery, dormant energy)
Trigger global world changes on activation

systems.name: 11.2 Ancient Kaiju Enemy Emergence
systems.notes: Colossal roaming kaiju: Sand Wyrm, Magma Leviathan, Storm Roc. They threaten player bases and reshape terrain.
tasks: Design each kaiju's appearance, movement, and attack patterns
Implement kaiju spawning logic (biome-specific, post-Sun Engine)
Add base threat system (kaiju can damage camp structures)

systems.name: 11.3 Dreadnaught vs Kaiju Combat
systems.notes: Kaiju have weak points that must be exposed by the Engineer (targeting subsystem) while the Pilot maneuvers. Defeating a kaiju yields unique artifacts and fuels the Sun Engine.
tasks: Design kaiju attack telegraphs and phases
Create rewards: ancient artifacts, Sun Engine fuel

systems.name: 11.4 Escalating World Events
systems.notes: The more you awaken, the more frequent and intense the ancient incursions. Players can choose to keep the world quiet or push for greater rewards.
tasks: Increase kaiju spawn rate and strength with meter
Allow players to pause escalation via certain actions
Broadcast world events to all players
